name: 33172 · Doral, FL
findings: ZIP 33172 (Doral) has 135 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33172 (Doral) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
56% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33172 (Doral) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 66% of all organizations here have no identified type.
